Done — adapter v0.7.2 live with workspace tools, all smoke-tested:

**New tools (only exposed when the run has a project workspace — `context.paperclipWorkspace.cwd`, falling back to the agent's configured `cwd`):**
- `read_file` — relative path, optional offset/limit, 50K char cap
- `write_file` — creates parent dirs, overwrite semantics
- `list_dir` — skips `.git`/`node_modules`, 200-entry cap
- `run_command` — shell exec with cwd = workspace root, 60s default / 300s max timeout, stdout/stderr/exitCode returned

All file paths are confined to the workspace root — `../etc/passwd` correctly rejected. Verified end-to-end: write → read → command → cleanup all returned `ok`.

Also added a protocol rule so models actually use them: "if workspace tools are available, do the file/command work yourself instead of only commenting about it" — that's exactly what the readme agents failed at (GLI-237 blocked itself because it had no way to touch files).

Loaded via fresh r10 install + reload, so it's live now — no server restart. One caveat: the readme agents' tasks must be attached to a project with a workspace, otherwise the run gets no `paperclipWorkspace.cwd` and the file tools won't appear — if GLI-237/238 weren't linked to a project, that's the remaining setup step on your side.
